verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury lets platforms create a FinancialAccount for each connected account and create a 'financial address' to fund it (docs-7, docs-16, docs-23). Platform-owned and connected-account financial accounts form a rough master/sub structure (docs-5, docs-10), and Transaction ledger objects support reconciliation (docs-13, docs-19). However, the evidence never explicitly says each account gets its own account and routing numbers, and it doesn't address issuing them at scale. missing for 10: explicit documentation of unique account/routing numbers per financial address, virtual-account semantics for reconciliation, evidence of provisioning at scale, a formal master/sub-account hierarchy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
